relations: Expanding firework bursts fade over time, so their mirrored streaks on the water dim and shift accordingly.
Ripples on the dark water surface distort the reflected light columns as the fireworks above evolve.
Distant horizon lights persist steadily while the aerial bursts bloom and decay above them.
Residual smoke from the explosions drifts slowly against the night sky behind the new bursts.
